name: Employment related income
description: Employment related income covers how various employment-related payments are treated for clients already receiving a benefit, as distinct from treatment at commencement of benefit.

attributes.summary: A concept defining the types and treatment of employment-related income for benefit recipients, distinguishing between income at commencement and ongoing benefit scenarios.
attributes.definition: Employment related income covers wages and salary, parental leave payments, self-employment, commission work, goods/services/accommodation in lieu of money, compensation or damages, home-based education and care service payments, honoraria, carer allowances, jury service fees, sponsorship, friendly society payments, green dollar trading, voluntary work, and expenses reimbursed by employers.
attributes.context: Page describes the treatment of employment-related income for clients already receiving a benefit. References commencement date treatment under individual benefit types.
